C212.notes: SER AF-ER-001. Photo confirmed (no text drip). Reverse greater kudu left · STATE OF ERITREA · 1997 · 50 · FIFTY CENTS. First-year nakfa coinage — independence 1993, currency introduced 1997; Asmara / market / bus odd-change in a brand-new money. Country #37 — first Eritrea / first Horn of Africa (after Nigeria C201 / AF-NG-001 West Africa). Eritrea flips now 1.

C212.story: A 1997 50 cents from Eritrea. The obverse shows State of Eritrea arms with a camel; the reverse shows greater kudu left; STATE OF ERITREA, 1997, 50, FIFTY CENTS. Struck in nickel-plated steel.
open_questions: Type catalogued KM#46, but two independent references (heritcoin, CoinZoo) list the 1997 Eritrea 50 cents (greater kudu, nickel-plated steel) as KM#47; KM#46 is the 25 cents (zebra). Likely an off-by-one transcription slip - verify.
